newsitem.title: EGYPT: Three suspected militants shot dead in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Three suspected militants shot dead in Egypt.

text.p: Egyptian police shot dead three suspected militants during a search operation in southern Egypt, security sources said.

The sources said police where combing fields on Friday near Abu Qurqas, 250 km (150 miles) south of Cairo, when they were ambushed by suspected militants. Police killed three of the attackers and two police were wounded in the ensuing battle.
The sources also said late on Friday that the three were suspected of belonging to the military wing of al-Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), the main Islamist militant group.
Eight Coptic Christians were gunned down in April in an attack in Abu Qurqas in which police suspected the Gama'a. The group denied responsibility.
More than 1,000 people have been killed in political violence since the militants took up arms in 1992 to topple the government of President Hosni Mubarak.
